page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for intensive parallel computing workloads. It features 48 physical Intel Xeon 8462Y+ cores on the x86_64 architecture, running at 2.0 GHz with a shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, providing 20.0 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a combined 320 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, requiring external storage solutions for persistent data.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core and memory performance. The multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng is rated as strong at 96,293.69, while the Passmark CPU score reaches a top-tier rating of 85,426.66. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with small-block read-only cached bandwidth reaching a top-tier 7,649.82 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the server achieves top-tier performance in LLM inference for small models, processing 10,308.98 tokens per second during prompt processing and 377.14 tokens per second during text generation.

The hardware profile offers high resource density, combining massive memory capacity with high-end GPU accelerators, which represents a specialized cost-efficiency profile for deep learning and large-scale data processing. However, the shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage are notable architectural tradeoffs that require workloads to rely on network-attached storage. This server is optimized for large-scale AI and machine learning workloads, LLM inference, parallel scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing.
description: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a high-density GPU-accelerated server designed for parallel computing and machine learning. It features 48 Intel Xeon 8462Y+ vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture, 960.0 GB of RAM, and four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with 320 GB of total VRAM. Running on a KVM hypervisor, the instance utilizes a shared CPU allocation and contains no local storage. Benchmarks show top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, multi-threaded decompression, and small-model LLM inference, where it processes 10,308.98 tokens per second. This server is highly suited for deep learning, large-scale AI inference, and complex scientific simulations.
